headlines.title: 法国央行预计第三季度经济保持增长势头
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。

headlines.title_en: French central bank expects economy to maintain growth momentum in Q3
headlines.summary_en: The Bank of France said the French economy is expected to maintain growth momentum this quarter, supported by growth in key sectors and cooling inflation. The central bank, citing a monthly business survey, said Tuesday it expects GDP to grow 0.2% in the third quarter. That would match the previous quarter and slightly exceed the 0.1% forecast by analysts in a Bloomberg survey. The Bank of France said economic activity will continue to be driven by the services sector, including transport, information and communications, while manufacturing rebounded in August. Looking ahead, the energy sector is expected to expand, but construction could decline further due to fewer public contracts. Meanwhile, the Bank of France warned that the economy still faces "significant uncertainties," citing "the geopolitical situation in the Middle East and weather conditions until the end of summer, when new heat waves could still occur."

headlines.summary:

headlines.title_en: Brazil plans to issue 5 billion yuan panda bonds in China this year
headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua Finance, Brazil's Ministry of Finance recently stated that Brazil plans to issue renminbi-denominated sovereign panda bonds in the Chinese market for the first time within 2026, with a planned issuance size of 5 billion yuan. If the first issuance goes smoothly, Brazil will consider forming a regular issuance mechanism in the future, and by establishing a sovereign bond pricing benchmark, create conditions for Brazilian companies to enter China's bond market and expand renminbi financing channels.

headlines.title: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”，分析称债市调整多出于止盈需求
headlines.summary: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”。8月11日，央行未开展7天期逆回购操作，当日有465亿元逆回购到期，公开市场实现净回笼465亿元。8月11日，资金面总体平稳，债市则在前期连续走强后震荡回调。受访人士认为，此次逆回购“零操作”主要缘于月初流动性充裕、金融机构融资需求下降。债市调整更多来自收益率快速下行后的止盈需求。随着税期临近、政府债券发行提速，加之超长债交易趋于拥挤，债券市场短期内仍将有所波动。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC reverse repos show zero operations again; analysts say bond market adjustment mostly driven by profit-taking
headlines.summary_en: The central bank's reverse repos again saw "zero operations." On August 11, the PBOC carried out no 7-day reverse repo operations, with 46.5 billion yuan in reverse repos maturing that day, resulting in a net withdrawal of 46.5 billion yuan from the open market. On August 11, funding conditions were generally stable, while the bond market pulled back in choppy trading after a period of consecutive gains. Those surveyed believe that this "zero operation" of reverse repos was mainly due to ample liquidity at the beginning of the month and reduced financing demand from financial institutions. The bond market adjustment came more from profit-taking demand after rapid yield declines. With the tax period approaching, government bond issuance accelerating, and ultra-long bond trading becoming crowded, the bond market will still fluctuate in the short term. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 下半年A股投资图谱浮现：科技为矛、改善为盾，两大核心主线成机构共识
headlines.summary: 进入下半年，A股市场在震荡磨底中加快寻找新的运行主线。多方调研获悉，多家一线机构已形成明确共识：机构资金可依托基本面研究适度左侧布局，普通投资者在右侧信号出现时可进一步提高风险偏好；在配置方向上，应由单一赛道抱团转向科技成长、基本面改善与高股息资产的均衡组合。AI产业趋势延续、政策支持持续加码以及资本市场双向开放提速，将为下半年结构性行情提供支撑，但海外货币政策、地缘局势等不确定因素仍需警惕。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: H2 A-share investment map emerges: tech as the spear, improvement as the shield, two core main lines become institutional consensus
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of the year, the A-share market is accelerating its search for a new operating mainline amid volatile bottoming. Multi-channel research has learned that several leading institutions have formed a clear consensus: institutional funds can make moderate left-side allocations based on fundamentals research, while ordinary investors can increase risk appetite when right-side signals appear; in terms of allocation direction, they should shift from single-track herding to a balanced portfolio of tech growth, fundamental improvement, and high-dividend assets. The continuation of the AI industry trend, continued policy support, and accelerated two-way opening of the capital market will support structural market conditions in the second half of the year, but uncertainties such as overseas monetary policy and geopolitical situations still warrant caution. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 公募调仓方向渐显，医药生物关注度升温

headlines.title_en: Public fund positioning shifts become apparent, biomedical attention rises
headlines.summary_en: Public funds are searching for new structural opportunities, with pharmaceutical and biology becoming a key focus. The latest calculated data shows that the overall position of public equity funds has further risen to 94.34%, at a mid-to-high historical level. At the same time, signs of public fund position shifts are gradually emerging, with food and beverage, non-bank financials, and banking receiving active increases, while previously hot sectors such as electronics have been reduced. It is worth noting that institutional research trends have also changed. From August 3 to 9, public fund institutions conducted 104 research visits to the biomedicine industry, with heat surpassing the electronics industry that had previously received sustained attention. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 韩国主权财富基金加入全球人工智能、机器人领域角逐
headlines.summary: 韩国计划于明年向一支全新主权财富基金投入超 1 万亿韩元（合 7.07 亿美元）新增资金，重点布局人工智能及其他战略产业，跟进全球多国政府的行动，调动投资力量，以期在高科技领域取得竞争优势。韩国负责创新与增长事务的财政部副部长Min Kyung-seol周二接受媒体采访时表示：“细节暂不便透露，但明年投资规模区间或在 6000 亿韩元至 1 万亿韩元以上。” 他称，最终投资金额会视筛选出的投资标的及其资金需求，有可能超过初步预估。Min Kyung-seol表示，现阶段该基金暂无直接投资三星电子、SK 海力士的计划，这两家芯片企业已是全球人工智能浪潮的核

headlines.title_en: Korea sovereign wealth fund joins global AI and robotics race
headlines.summary_en: South Korea plans to inject more than 1 trillion won ($707 million) in new funds into a new sovereign wealth fund next year, focusing on AI and other strategic industries, following the actions of governments worldwide in mobilizing investment power to gain competitive advantages in high-tech fields. Min Kyung-seol, South Korea's vice minister of finance for innovation and growth, said in an interview with media on Tuesday: "Details cannot be disclosed yet, but the investment scale next year could range from 600 billion won to over 1 trillion won." He said the final investment amount may exceed initial estimates, depending on selected investment targets and their funding needs. Min Kyung-seol said that at this stage, the fund has no plans to directly invest in Samsung Electronics or SK Hynix, two chip companies already at the core of the global AI wave...

headlines.title: 宏观利好叠加工业需求加持 银价短期有望偏强震荡
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。

headlines.title: 生物医药赛道迎来机构扎堆调研，商业化与全球化进展成关注重点
headlines.summary: 数据显示，8月1日至11日，生物医药行业获机构调研热度高涨，获调研家数在全部申万一级行业中排名第一，百济神州、泽璟制药、九洲药业等11家公司受到机构青睐。从调研内容看，公司管线的研发和商业化进展、出海的最新规划和BD（商务拓展）交易动态，是机构关注的重点。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Biomedical track sees dense institutional research, commercialization and globalization progress become focus
headlines.summary_en: Data shows that from August 1 to 11, the biomedicine industry received surging institutional research attention, ranking first in the number of companies researched across all Shenwan first-level industries. Eleven companies including BeiGene, Zai Lab, and Jiuzhou Pharmaceutical were favored by institutions. Judging from the research content, the R&D and commercialization progress of company pipelines, latest overseas plans, and BD (business development) transaction dynamics are the key focuses of institutional attention. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率跌超2个基点
headlines.summary: 周二（8月11日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌1.63个基点，报4.6904%，北京时间18:00-21:46持续走低，从4.73%附近下挫至4.6659%刷新日低。 两年期美债收益率跌2.10个基点，报4.22%；30年期美债收益率跌0.86个基点，报5.2424%。 2/10年期美债收益率利差涨0.479个基点，报+46.826个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率跌0.27个基点，至2.4274%；两年期TIPS收益率涨0.18个基点，至2.0357%；30年期TIPS收益率跌0.13个基点，至3.0183%。

headlines.title_en: US 2-year Treasury yield falls over 2 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (August 11) New York afternoon, the US 10-year Treasury yield fell 1.63 basis points to 4.6904%, continuously declining from 18:00 to 21:46 Beijing time, falling from around 4.73% to a daily low of 4.6659%. The 2-year Treasury yield fell 2.10 basis points to 4.22%; the 30-year Treasury yield fell 0.86 basis points to 5.2424%. The 2/10-year Treasury yield spread rose 0.479 basis points to +46.826 basis points. The 10-year TIPS yield fell 0.27 basis points to 2.4274%; the 2-year TIPS yield rose 0.18 basis points to 2.0357%; the 30-year TIPS yield fell 0.13 basis points to 3.0183%.

headlines.title: 锂云母提锂多项技术难题攻克
headlines.summary: 11日从中国有色金属工业协会获悉，近日，中铝国际长沙有色冶金设计研究院有限公司牵头完成的“锂云母高效提锂技术与装备研发及应用”项目，成功攻克了我国锂云母提锂长期面临的设备腐蚀、回转窑结圈、回收率低等重大技术难题，实现大规模工业化生产，标志着我国复杂低品位锂云母资源高值化利用迈出关键一步。（科技日报）

headlines.title_en: Multiple technical challenges in extracting lithium from lepidolite overcome
headlines.summary_en: According to the China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association on the 11th, the 'Efficient Lithium Extraction Technology and Equipment Development and Application' project led by Changsha Nonferrous Metallurgy Design and Research Institute Co., Ltd. under China Aluminum International Engineering Corporation has successfully overcome major technical challenges such as equipment corrosion, rotary kiln ring formation, and low recovery rates that have long plagued lithium extraction from lepidolite in China, achieving large-scale industrial production. This marks a key step in the high-value utilization of complex, low-grade lepidolite resources in China. (Science and Technology Daily)

headlines.summary: 人工智能（AI）算力需求持续爆发，全球算力基建迎来大规模投资热潮。为适配算力高速增长带来的交付提速需求，阿里云发布新一代全模块化人工智能数据中心架构，海内外科技巨头加码智算设施。叠加国内政策持续助推绿色算力与算力网建设，市场空间加速释放，数据中心产业链迎来发展窗口期。A股布局数据中心产业链的概念股超过百只。8月11日，城地香江、杭钢股份涨停，盛弘股份上涨12.92%，旭光电子、铜牛信息等跟涨。从业绩来看，45只概念股公布半年度业绩相关公告。按半年报、业绩快报、业绩预告净利润下限顺序统计，24股归母净利润实现同比增长，其中利通电子、富瀚微同比增幅均在100

headlines.title_en: Data center industry chain enters development window, 24 concept stocks report positive H1 results
headlines.summary_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) computing power demand continues to surge, and global computing infrastructure is ushering in a wave of large-scale investment. To adapt to the accelerated delivery needs brought by rapid computing power growth, Alibaba Cloud released a new generation of fully modular AI data center architecture, and domestic and overseas tech giants are increasing investment in intelligent computing facilities. Combined with continued domestic policy support for green computing power and computing network construction, market space is rapidly being released, and the data center industry chain is ushering in a window of development. A-shares have more than 100 concept stocks in the data center industry chain. On August 11, Chengdi Xiangjiang and Hangang Steel hit the daily limit up, Shenghong Shares rose 12.92%, and Xuguang Electronics, Tongniu Information and others followed with gains. In terms of performance, 45 concept stocks have released semi-annual performance-related announcements. According to statistics in the order of semi-annual reports, performance express reports, and lower limits of performance forecasts, 24 stocks saw year-on-year growth in net profit attributable to parent companies, among which Litong Electronics and Fuhong Micro had year-on-year increases both above 100%...
